build_Attention_block: build a multi-head self-attention layer with rope embeddings and configurable attention implementation
build_Block_transformer: build a transformer encoder block with self-attention, mlp, and stochastic depth drop path
build_DecoderBlock: build a transformer decoder block with self-attention, cross-attention, and memory normalization
build_PatchEmbed: build a patch embedding layer that converts images to flattened patch tokens with positions
build_Mlp: build a two-layer MLP with gelu activation and dropout for vision transformer networks
